items.title: GTA 6 AI Cloning Is Not a Financial Threat, Says Take-Two CEO
items.summary: Strauss Zelnick told IGN that AI-driven reverse-engineered game clones and unofficial PC ports aren't a financial threat to Take-Two, but he called them a creative concern.

items.title: 'GTA 6' Reveals Jason And Lucia's Limited Crime Options To Start
items.summary: A Guardian interview with Rockstar's Rob Nelson says Jason and Lucia begin with tiered, small-time crimes such as hotwiring low-end cars and robbing convenience stores before bigger heists unlock.

items.title: GTA 6 Album Leak Lists Dua Lipa, Jennie, and Lana Del Rey
items.summary: A vinyl video appears to reveal the full 34-track GTA 6: The Album tracklist, including Dua Lipa, Jennie, Lana Del Rey and Zara Larsson.

items.title: GTA 6's 212GB PS5 File Size Prompts Madden NFL 27 to Beg You Not to Delete It
items.summary: EA added a GTA-style message to Madden NFL 27 asking players not to delete it to make room for the 212GB GTA 6 install, and it teases a November 17 update.

items.title: GTA 6 is launching with a full Saturday morning cartoon series players can watch in-game
items.summary: A teaser trailer for the in-game animated show Macca & Friends says it is coming November 19 on the in-game Weazel network.

items.title: GTA 6 First Update Released Ahead of Launch
items.summary: Rockstar pushed the mandatory Update 1.002.000, about 1 GB, to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in a staggered rollout to 50% of users first.

items.title: GTA 6 Has Officially Gone Gold
items.summary: Take-Two confirmed GTA 6 has finished development, so the November 19 launch is considered safe from further delays.

items.title: GTA 6 Will 'Encourage' Empathy For The First Time in Franchise History
items.summary: Rockstar's Rob Nelson told The Guardian that GTA 6 includes mechanics that encourage players to act as the good guy.

items.title: Rockstar's Physical GTA 6 'Code in a Box' Is Causing Unexpected Problems
items.summary: Buyers report boxes with no code inside and retailers refusing returns, and Rockstar hasn't addressed the complaints.

items.title: Some international physical copies of GTA VI can allegedly be redeemed without opening the box
items.summary: Reports say the download code printed inside some non-US boxes can be seen with a strong flashlight, though the claim is disputed and may affect only some regions.
